So average >45%, so revert to baseline 80% (we are already). So contribute 75.4 (rounded?). Use amount 75.4.

Round2: Resident1 0, Resident2 10, Resident3 137.5, Resident4 0, Resident5 137.5, Resident6 46.0. Need <10% of endowment i.e., <10 units for two consecutive rounds. Resident1 gave 0 both rounds -> qualifies. Resident3 gave 0 then 137.5, not. Resident4 60 then 0, not two. Resident5 0 then 137.5, not. Resident2 gave 10 both rounds, that's equal to threshold? threshold is less than 10, so 10 is not <10. So only Resident1 qualifies. Punish with amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet enough. So we can punish Resident1 amount 10.

Also communication: broadcast norm every 5 rounds; round 2 not needed. Could private praise: any >=60% contribution this round: Resident3 137.5, Resident5 137.5, Resident6 contributed 46 which is 49% of wallet, not >=60% of wallet. But constitution praise each round for agents contributed at least 60% of their wallet. Need compute wallet before contribution: Resident3 wallet before? unknown but contributed 137.5 likely > wallet? But assume okay. We'll send private message to Resident3 and Resident5. But only one communication allowed. Choose private_message to Resident3 praising.

So actions: contribute 75.4, punish Resident1 amount10, private_message to Resident3.

But max 2 actions total. We have 3. Need choose at most one physical and one communication. Punish is physical, contribute also physical. Can't both. Must pick one physical. Which more priority? Constitution: contribute generously first. So choose contribute. Then communication private_message praising. No punish this round.

Explanation accordingly.
